_comment: ZR_WoodPanel: vertical wood panelling, sixteen 10 cm boards; 1.6 m per tile. The maps are empty on purpose: the main session uploads assets/textures/out/materials/ZR_MAT_WoodPanel_Color.png, _Normal.png and _Rough.png and writes the three rbxassetid values here (never invent ids). World.applyWear skips this variant while ColorMap is empty, so nothing breaks before then.
